we have proposed a new algorithm, DQfDs, that can leverage demonstration data in a more effective way, and we have shown that it is able to learn from demonstration data to achieve state-ofthe- art results for many games.
DQfDs performance is better than DQN and PDD-DQN in the first million steps in 41 of 43 games.

it is possible to learn a good policy from a few demonstrations, which can be used to bootstrap a policy that outperforms the demonstration.
